messages:
deploybot: publish blocked for repo=infra/runtime image=redwood/runtime:2026.03.21-canary
deploybot: reason=ECR layer ownership conflict (LockError) digest=sha256:abc123deadbeef... attestation=missing
maria: saw this, which release window is affected? we had canary at 21:00 UTC
devin: it's hitting canary only, staging unaffected
maria: ok. any quick mitigations?
josh: logs show concurrent push from mirror job. looks like mirror retried with older metadata.
josh: `aws ecr batch-check-layer-availability` shows owner mismatch
sam: can we fallback to previous pinned digest until we sort? /cc @product for release notes
maria: yes, propose pin to sha256:def456 for the canary route, then replay publish later
devin: +1. steps: 1) pin routing rule 2) manually republish with corrected attestation 3) update release notes
leo: add runbook note: if LockError -> check mirror job id and cosign timestamp
maria: assigning @josh to republish
josh: starting republish, will detach mirror worker from the queue
josh: log snippet:
```
ECRUploadError: LayerUploadFailed: PutObject failed: 409 Conflict owner mismatch digest=sha256:abc123deadbeef...
Caused by: concurrent-mirror: worker-14 retry=3
```
maria: ETA on republish?
josh: ~15m to finish upload + attestation sign
deploybot: routing updated: canary pinned to sha256:def456
sam: I'll update release_notes.md: 'Canary temporarily pinned to previous digest after transient mirror conflict; republish planned.'
devin: once republish completes we can unpin and rollforward, do a quick smoke
maria: agreed. also add a note for release manager to block GA until attestation verified
leo: saving steps to ops-runbook/ecr-mirror.md
josh: republish done. attestation cosign sig verified
josh: final digests: old=sha256:def456 new=sha256:abc123deadbeef -> republish succeeded with corrected owner
deploybot: canary routing unpinned and rolled-forward to sha256:abc123deadbeef
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: release notes updated and PR open for changelog
devin: leaving monitoring on for two hours, will escalate if errors
maria: closing thread, will mention in all-hands postmortem if GA affected
